content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Akron

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Verify you meet PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Akron's manufacturing and logistics sectors employ many professionals who already qualify. Review PMI's current eligibility criteria—our admissions team can clarify whether your background fits.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP Boot Camp. Our instructors deliver PMI's required contact hours through structured, interactive sessions you can join from home or office. This foundation covers all five process groups and knowledge areas tested on the PMP exam.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Register with PMI and submit your formal application, including proof of education and project experience. Pay the PMI exam fee at that time. Our team guides you through every form and deadline so your application reaches PMI without delay.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor Q&A sessions—to build confidence. Schedule your computerized PMP exam at a local Pearson VUE testing center. Our support continues through your exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a standard three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing training and workshops that count toward your PDU requirement, helping you stay current in project-management practices.
